law_record.title: Posted places (A)(4)
law_record.text: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: Within the following distances of any fire hydrant, whether or not the location is posted with a sign, whether or not the adjacent curb or roadway surface is painted red, and whether the location is on public or private property: (a) At a location where parallel parking is permitted, fifteen feet; (b) At a location where angle parking is permitted or no parking is permitted, twenty feet.

activation_conditions: a fire hydrant is beside the roadway
the subject stops, stands or parks within fifteen feet where parallel parking is permitted, or within twenty feet where angle parking or no parking is permitted
exceptions: when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
in compliance with the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device
residue: which distance applies turns on what kind of parking is permitted at the place, which is a map or sign fact rather than a hydrant fact
the rule applies whether or not the curb is painted or a sign posted, so a rule keyed to curb colour alone misses it
summary.subject: driver
